newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai Kaikai opens up 12.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai Kaikai opens up 12.5 pct.

text.p: Shanghai Kaikai Industrial B shares, making their debut on the Shanghai stock exchange on Wednesday, opened up 12.5 percent to $0.288 percent against an issue price of $0.256.
Traders said investors viewed the issue price as being low, making it an attractive buy.
Analysts earlier predicted that Kaikai would perform strongly on its first day, possibly opening as high as $0.30.
But traders today said the news that 33 more companies had been chosen for B share listings had had a negative impact on the listing.
Shanghai Kaikai Industrial Co Ltd is one of China's largest shirt and sweater makers. It claims a 5.7 percent share of the national market for shirts and 2.5 percent for sweaters.
The company said it had raised $19.15 million from the issue of the 80 million B shares last month, excluding issue costs.
It says proceeds will be used to expand the firm's clothing production and to open new sales outlets around China.
